examples.title: Small warehouse furniture and aisle teaching grid
examples.summary: Original five-by-five warehouse interior sketch with two small furniture footprints and a connected orthogonal aisle. Illustrates access metadata, not an efficient or optimal storage design.
examples.author: Songs of Syx AI Assistant project (Codex-authored original teaching example)
examples.materials_note: No bill of materials is calculated. Building, roofing, doors, item costs, upgrades and resource allocations require separate current-game checks.
caveats: Native review establishes the selected item footprint and public access flags only; no room is built.
The entry is hypothetical and walls, roof and exterior map are not modeled. All coordinates are relative to the authored interior rectangle.
Two furniture instances do not establish two crates, storage capacity, throughput, staffing or efficiency.
This is an original instructional example, not a copied community blueprint, Workshop export or video reconstruction. No redistribution license is granted by this record.
